CHANGED: exam.ex manages_entity_types (6), session.ex/certificate.ex/anti_cheat.ex (exam_owner/0 helper via ManagedTypes.owner_for!(Exam), 5 Records /3 call sites), priv/modules/exam/pack.json regenerated (10 -> 16, pure additions, existing 10 byte-identical) and generate_pack.exs (16 names, pack_dir fixed to priv/modules/exam), tenant_provisioning.ex (manifest entry + moduledoc), managed_types.ex moduledoc paragraph, docs 0050 amendment note and REQ-496 design D3 amendment. VERIFIED: MIX_ENV=test mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors -> 'Compiling 447 files (.ex) / Generated letflow app', no warnings; mix format --check-formatted clean; mix letflow.check_boundaries OK (1577 edges, 0 violations); trigger SQL smoke on a scratch schema (rolled back): no setting refused, setting+session ok, setting+tag refused, unstamp refused. NOT RUN: mix test, Stamp/TamperInventory against a real provisioned tenant, permission_matrix --check (fails baseline_is_head because the branch is at main HEAD, environmental; manifest permissions/role_grants unchanged). DEVIATIONS: (1) Stamp reads the exam manifest's manages_entity_types via Catalog.fetch("exam").manifest() instead of module_owner/1, because scan R3 allows module_owner only in managed_types.ex and installs.ex. (2) Existing pack-count tests of design 3.4 NOT edited (lead: no tests); they will fail on 10 vs 16 until TEST-DESIGNER updates them. (3) TamperInventory accepts an extra optional :cap opt (default 10_000) for the per-tenant cap.
